name: Notifications
author: Tulpar Control
description: The light bar flashes when a Windows notification arrives from one of the apps you choose. It only sees which app sent it, not what it says.

settings.label: Apps
settings.description: Names as Windows shows them, separated by commas: WhatsApp, Discord, Outlook. Add =#RRGGBB for a color of its own: Discord=#5865F2. Empty: every app.
